biotools.summary: COSMOPharm is a Python-based tool that utilizes COSMO-SAC to predict the thermodynamic compatibility of drugs and polymers in amorphous solid dispersions. It facilitates the selection of optimal polymeric carriers to enhance drug bioavailability by calculating solubility and miscibility.
